thesis: Narrow, mechanical BaFin disclosure-review question, not an antitrust question. Statutory clock (4-week submission + 10-15 working-day review) straddles the Sept-1 cutoff; no confirmed approval as of day 42 of 47 pushes this to roughly a coin flip, slightly below CP/gold consensus given deal complexity.

thesis: Confidential DRS with the SEC since 2026-05-22 and every mechanical gate cleared, but OpenAI guided away from 2026 twice (NYT 2026-06-25; CFO Friar 'public company in 2027' on 2026-08-19), with the $122B March round removing capital urgency and Altman refusing to price below $1T. Polymarket puts a 2026 listing at ~15%; I add ~5pp because this resolves on the filing, and Reg S-X's 45-day staleness cliff plus SoftBank's $40B bridge maturing 2027-03-25 keep a December-2026 public flip live.

Bilateral truces already happened twice in 2026 (April, May), so the binding constraint is purely the >=30-day-intent clause, which needs Putin to drop 'settlement first'. Bloomberg (26 Aug, three Kremlin sources) reports talks at a dead end and escalation planned; a 300k-500k mobilisation is expected right after the 18-20 Sep Duma elections; Ukraine is funded through 2027 by the EU's EUR90bn loan. 3pp under a unanimous Metaculus (CP=Pro=gold=12.0%), mainly because the crowd appears not to price the effective-by-31-Dec clause.

Science and review speed are no longer the constraint (two positive pivotals; CNPV record of 24-61 day reviews; executive order), but the COMP360 NDA is still unfiled on 2026-08-31 with guidance no sharper than Q4, and Q4 submissions cluster in December — only ~11% of the completion-date mass is early enough for filing plus a ~50-day review to land inside 2026.

Netanyahu is already caretaker PM and stays PM until a successor is sworn in, so only a rival government installed inside the 65-day window from the 27 Oct election resolves YES; the first mandate (28+14 days, assigned ~9-14 Nov) expires ~21-26 Dec, so YES needs first-mandate success rather than unusual speed. Real-money markets put him at 28-30% to be the next PM; I take the timing conditional at ~0.50 vs the community's ~0.37, tempered by Ra'am below threshold and a right-leaning Israeli polling error.

No tripwire fired in 4 days since v1; window compressed to 2 days with new CNN reporting confirming CAISI leadership vacuum/interagency turf fight (why nothing has moved). All three cohorts fell in tandem (CP/gold to 1.0%, Pro to 2.7%), converging. Land at 1.5%.

Metrics year 2026 is inflated by Coefficient Giving raising its 2026 GiveWell allocation from $175m to $1bn (2026-07-23), explicitly 'a one-off surge rather than a new steady state' - a fact the question background omits. Anthropic's imminent IPO puts employee liquidity at the start of metrics year 2027 and the full AI-wealth wave inside 2028, roughly cancelling the cliff in 2027 and outgrowing it in 2028. Ledger number is the 2027 leg; 2028 leg forecast median +36.5%, IQR [-11.0, +110.0]. No community prediction exists (0 forecasters).
